About Studio 87

A Kuantan salon since 2017.

Book on WhatsApp

Studio 87 has done hair on Jalan Bukit Sekilau in Kuantan since 2017. The salon has orange leather chairs and tall black-framed mirrors, and much of our work is colour: ash browns, milk tea, honey and copper, highlights and balayage.

We start every visit with a consultation, because the right colour depends on the hair you walk in with. Then we take the time the work needs.

Sabrina is one of the stylists credited on our official Facebook posts.
